explication: Type4Me is a macOS voice-input app, with an iOS voice keyboard companion. Its primary workflow is a hotkey-triggered recording, speech recognition, optional text processing, and insertion at the focused cursor. Other documented branches include selection-based questions, text revision, Mac actions, vocabulary and snippet replacement, usage history, and configuration sync to iOS. The README supports the product-level workflow; sampled source is partial, so internal orchestration and several subsystem links are not asserted beyond documented behavior.
